security_audit.summary: The nine static findings are false positives: Markdown fences, a documentation link, an optional Kakao credential reference, and readable multilingual prose. However, the loader executes an unreviewed, mutable npm package and adopts its output as instructions. A separate update command can modify unrelated agent skills beyond the restroom lookup task.

remediation.issue: The required loader executes a mutable npm package and trusts its generated instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions locally, pin any necessary CLI to an exact audited version, and require approval before remote execution.

remediation.issue: The update command targets every coding-agent skill installation, exceeding the lookup task.
remediation.suggestion: Remove global updates from the lookup workflow and require separate approval with an explicit list of affected installations.

content.user_title: Find Nearby Public Restrooms in South Korea
content.value_statement: Finding a nearby restroom can require checking several maps and public records. This skill guides location-based searches using official Korean restroom data and optional Kakao results.
actual_capabilities: Requires a user-provided location before searching and accepts neighborhoods, stations, landmarks, or coordinates.
Defines a search workflow using official nationwide or regional public-restroom CSV data.
Uses Kakao Map anchor searches to resolve place names into coordinates.
Specifies optional Kakao Local API searches for public restrooms, open restrooms, and gas stations.
Specifies haversine distance ranking and deduplication within 50 meters, prioritizing official CSV records.
Requests concise results with facility names, addresses, distances, opening details, and map links.
limitations: The supplied files contain instructions and an example, not the search implementation; execution depends on external software and online services.
Coverage targets South Korea, and ambiguous place names can produce an incorrect search anchor.
Public data does not confirm live occupancy, locked doors, or current access; listed distances are straight-line estimates.
Kakao Local API enrichment requires a configured credential; searches without it may miss facilities.

use_cases.title: Find Facilities Near a Station
use_cases.description: Request nearby public restrooms around a Korean station and compare reported distances and opening details.

use_cases.title: Check Options Around a Work Stop
use_cases.description: Provide a neighborhood or coordinates to request a short restroom list between scheduled stops.

use_cases.title: Review Facilities Around a Meeting Point
use_cases.description: Compare nearby public and open restrooms around a planned gathering location, with source-based opening information.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Nearby Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me find a nearby public restroom in South Korea. Ask for my location before searching.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: start without providing a location.

prompt_templates.title: Search Around a Landmark
prompt_templates.prompt: My current location is [station or landmark] in [city]. Find three nearby public restrooms with addresses and map links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: provide a recognizable search anchor.

prompt_templates.title: Search from Coordinates
prompt_templates.prompt: My location is [latitude, longitude]. List five nearby restrooms by straight-line distance and include recorded opening hours and data sources.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: use a precise search origin.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Sources and Uncertainty
prompt_templates.prompt: Search near [location] using official data and optional configured Kakao enrichment. Merge duplicates within 50 meters and explain missing hours or uncertain anchors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review source coverage and result quality.

output_examples.output: What is your current location? Please provide a neighborhood, station, landmark, or latitude and longitude.

output_examples.input: Can you guarantee that a listed restroom is unlocked and available right now?
output_examples.output: No. Public data does not report live occupancy or lock status. Recorded opening hours can help, but current access remains unverified.
Which city and station do you mean? Please provide a nearby landmark or coordinates so I can confirm the search location.

best_practices: Provide a clear landmark or coordinates and confirm the resolved location before comparing results.
Check recorded opening hours and access restrictions, and treat straight-line distance as an estimate rather than a walking route.
Review external CLI commands before execution, use an audited exact version, and keep API credentials out of chat.
anti_patterns: Treating listed opening hours as proof that a restroom is unlocked or unoccupied.
Assuming an ambiguous place name identifies the correct city or neighborhood.
Running global skill updates or sharing plaintext API keys as part of a restroom lookup.

faq.question: Where does this skill search?
faq.answer: The documented workflow targets South Korea using official nationwide and regional public-restroom data.

faq.question: Does it detect my location automatically?
faq.answer: No. It asks for your current location and accepts a neighborhood, station, landmark, or coordinates.

faq.question: Is a Kakao API key required?
faq.answer: The instructions allow official CSV searches without a Kakao REST API key. A configured key enables additional Kakao Local results.

faq.question: Are the distances walking distances?
faq.answer: No. The workflow recalculates straight-line haversine distances from coordinates rather than walking routes.

faq.question: Does it confirm current availability?
faq.answer: No. The documented sources do not confirm real-time occupancy or lock status, so opening information requires caution.

faq.question: Does the supplied skill include a complete search engine?
faq.answer: No. The files provide instructions and a Node.js example. The loader invokes an external CLI whose mutable version requires separate review.
